name: rendez-vous
description: Prise de rendez-vous auto-hébergée, mono-utilisateur, adossée à Google Agenda.

scripts.dev: CALENDAR_PROVIDER=mock DEMO_SEED=true ADMIN_EMAILS=admin@exemple.test DATA_DIR=./data node scripts/build.mjs --watch
scripts.dev:mock: npm run build && CALENDAR_PROVIDER=mock DEMO_SEED=true ADMIN_EMAILS=admin@exemple.test DATA_DIR=./data node --enable-source-maps dist/server.js
scripts.check: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm test
